description_en: Changes the status of a protection rule template
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-template-status --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 2249 --template-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseTemplateStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The new status of the protection rule template. Valid values:

0: Disabled.

1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的防护模板状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1：表示开启
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: The Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
